summary.headline: Katarchai and Effects of the Nodes
summary.text: Catalogue entries for folios 65–73 on cosmic effects of the ascending and descending nodes, rains, planetary conditions, lunar harm, conjunctions, full moons, and katarchai. The entries include methods for judging katarchai, the luminaries and Sun, lunar configurations, inquiries by the asker, star restorations, and the form of a katarche, with cross-references to codex 7 and Taurinensis CVII and a note on Teucer.
